checkMessages: Generated 30-second AVI loads a real video and a PCM audio stream.
Flyleaf returns an actual 320x180 decoded video frame.
Decoded frame contains the generated colored bars, not a solid placeholder.
Seeking changes the actual decoded frame pixels.
Experimental synchronization is enabled in both actual players.
Starting the active actual player starts its synchronized peer.
Pausing the active actual player pauses its synchronized peer.
Seeking the active actual player moves its synchronized peer near the same position.
Disabling synchronization restores independent seek control.
Pause all pauses both actual players after independent playback.
captureMethod: Flyleaf TakeSnapshotToBitmapSource of the actual decoded video frame; not a window screenshot
interaction: Real AVI with PCM audio, two Flyleaf windows, decoded frame snapshots, active-window play/pause/seek synchronization and independent playback
limitations: No physical key or native-control gestures or audibility claim from automation; recorded separately from user observations. Frames are decoder output, not a desktop screenshot. Synchronization checks do not promise frame-accurate timing.
